learning_profile.note: ACTIONABLE v2 calibration shows low-confidence directional forecasts underperform while MIXED 1-4 has strong leakage-safe hit rates; current macro/context conflict therefore favors MIXED rather than forcing a weak direction.

predictions.mechanism: Sharp sentiment miss is growth-negative, while hotter short- and long-run inflation expectations are hawkish; falling oil and a live equity rebound offset the bearish macro impulse.
predictions.invalidation: A sustained break lower in equities together with renewed rises in oil and Treasury yields would shift the setup bearish; a continued oil/yield decline with broad risk-on breadth would shift it bullish.

predictions.mechanism: Higher inflation expectations and very high Treasury yields pressure duration-sensitive tech, but easing oil and the current risk-on rebound counter the weak sentiment data.
predictions.invalidation: A renewed rise in US2Y/US10Y with weakening breadth would turn the signal bearish; a decisive yield retreat would turn it bullish.

predictions.mechanism: Weak consumer expectations hurt cyclical growth while inflation expectations raise rate risk; oil relief and positive index momentum offset part of that pressure.
predictions.invalidation: Clear confirmation of either broad risk-off with rising yields or durable risk-on with falling yields invalidates the mixed setup.

predictions.mechanism: Higher inflation expectations and weaker confidence support gold defensively, but a firm DXY and very high US yields are strong offsets.
predictions.invalidation: A decisive fall in real/nominal yields and DXY would make gold bullish; renewed yield and dollar strength would make it bearish.
